scenarios.scenario: You are a barista who has to tell a customer that their latte is actually a portal to another dimension.
You are a time-travelling tour guide explaining modern smartphones to someone from the 1800s.
You are a restaurant waiter who must calmly tell a customer that their order has escaped the kitchen.
You are a customer trying to return an obviously cursed object to a very skeptical shop owner.
You are a tech support agent helping a vampire set up video calls during daytime.
You are a yoga instructor teaching a class to robots who keep malfunctioning in the middle of poses.
You are a detective interrogating a talking parrot who is the only witness to a cookie theft.
You are a real estate agent trying to sell a house that's clearly haunted to a ghost skeptic.
You are a therapist counseling a superhero who's burned out from saving the world.
You are a museum guide explaining why the dinosaur exhibit keeps coming to life at night.
You are a chef on a cooking show where all your ingredients have gained consciousness.
You are a flight attendant announcing that the plane has accidentally flown into a fantasy realm.
You are a librarian shushing increasingly loud mythical creatures in the reading room.
You are a weather forecaster predicting ridiculous weather phenomena like raining cats and dogs (literally).
You are a driving instructor teaching a dragon how to parallel park.
